scope: Design completeness and implementability only; no product implementation or runtime acceptance
assessmentType: Two independent Codex native subagents; subjective design review, not an external certification

gaps: Pre-generated operation identity and restart reconciliation
Policy tightening timing and atomic admission
Initial OAuth public-client and endpoint configuration
Device, binding and policy-acceptance mutation contracts
OAuth discovery and fixed management resource paths
Local account selection within the existing current-origin UI
Explicit review, acceptance, manual-backup and unknown-result entry points
Separate usage identity binding from a manually chosen backup archive
Independent A/B prerequisites and concrete stage exit criteria

remainingItems: Freeze exact AAD serialization, field types and cross-implementation test vectors during protocol implementation
Confirm existing trusted Native, secret storage and transaction storage capabilities before wiring; fail closed if unavailable
Validate OAuth, DNS/connection restrictions, cross-tenant rejection and revocation races after implementation
Freeze exact AAD serialization, field types and an interoperability vector before implementing encrypted backup
Verify a clear mismatch state when the company browser session uses a different user or tenant from the Native connection
Specify a concrete status lookup for policy acceptance and other non-upload mutations
Define deliberate user archival of permanently unresolved operations before starting a distinct new backup; prohibit automatic replay
